info.title: Helpdesk Ticket Management API
info.description: REST API for the Helpdesk Ticket Management System. All endpoints under `/api/v1`. Authenticate via `POST /api/v1/auth/login` and send the returned JWT as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

put.description: Updates name/role/teamId. Cannot demote the last admin.

delete.description: Sets deleted=true. Blocked if user is referenced by active tickets or is the last admin.

post.description: Admin-only. Sets a new password on the target user without requiring the current password. Useful for support / locked-out accounts.

get.description:
Returns paginated tickets. Customers see only their own tickets.
Supports filtering by status, priority, assignee, category, date range,
and full-text search on subject/description.

put.description: Updates subject/description/priority/category. Closed tickets cannot be updated.

get.description:
Returns comments + history + attachments merged and sorted ASC by
createdAt. Customers see only external comments and no history.

400.description: Validation error / closed ticket / customer assignee

post.description: Transitions CLOSED → IN_PROGRESS and recomputes SLA due dates.

get.description: Customers see only external comments. Agents/admins see all.
Returns all 4 priorities with configured or default targets.

put.summary: Upsert SLA policy for a priority (admin)

get.description: Aggregated counts, breach rate, avg response/resolution times, by-priority, by-status, by-category.

delete.description: Blocked if the category is referenced by any ticket.

post.description: Self-service signup. Always creates a customer role.
Returns a JWT and basic user info.
Authenticated users (customer, agent, or admin) change **their own** password. Requires the current password for verification. The new password must be different from the current one.

400.description: Validation error (missing fields, too short, or newPassword equals currentPassword)

401.description: Missing/invalid JWT, or currentPassword is incorrect

post.description: Admin-only. Creates an agent or admin user with team assignment.
